dukkhayati.p: [Dukkha+ṇaya+ti] (kā,kri) CL=8 Nīti,dhā.19,370.] It causes suffering. be persecution. Dukkha - (1) - See. Dukkhayati(kri) [dukkha+ṇaya+ti. Nīti,dhā.2va.]  it make to be suffer.

DOP: dukkhati dukkhayati 1 , pr. 3 sg. [ BHS duḥkhati; cf S. Dhatup duḥkhati, duḥkhayati, Wg § 35:76 ], is painful, hurts; feels pain ; Dhātum 753 (sukha dukkha ca takriye); Ja III 26, 4 (kiṃ te samma ~atī ti pucchi, Ee so; Ce ~ayatī ti; Be dukkhan ti; Se kiṃ tvaṃ samma ~asī ti); Vism 264, 27 (gattāni ~anti) = Vibh-a 248, 1 ≠ Pj I 68, 5 ; Vism 527, 26 (~ayatī ti dukkhaṃ; or caus. ) = Ud-a 42, 9 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~āyatī ti); Sadd 327, 25 (sukha dukkha takkiriyāyaṃ, takkiriyā ti sukhadukkhānaṃ vedanānaṃ kiriyā sukhanaṃ dukkhanan ti vuttaṃ hoti, akammakā ime dhātavo: sukhati ~ati); 328, 11 (~atī ti dukkhito ti); — caus. ( a ) pr. 3 sg. dukkheti , ~ayati 2 , pains ; Vism 527, 26 (~ayatī ti dukkhaṃ; or dukkhayati 1 ); Sadd 328, 1 foll. (~eti ~ayati … ti imāni tesaṃ kāritapadarūpāni … Saddasatthe pana Dhātupāṭhasaṅkhepe ca ime dhātavo curādigaṇe yeva vuttā sukhayati ~ayatī ti ca akāritāni suddhakattupadāni icchitāni); — dukkhetī ti in Ee at It-a II 128, 1 is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se dukkhe ti; — pp dukkhita , dukhita, mfn. [ S. duḥkhita], in pain; ill; distressed ; Vin III 136, 15 (ahaṃ hi duggatā ~ā na sukhaṃ labhāmi); IV 291, 26 (~ā nāma gilānā vuccati); D II 24, 2 (addasā … Vipassī kumāro uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto purisaṃ ābādhikaṃ ~aṃ bāḷhagilānaṃ); Sn 984 (tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā Bāvarī ~o ahu; Pj II 582, 20 : ~o ti domanassajāto); Th 73 (jiṇṇaṃ ca disvā dukhitaṃ ca vyādhitaṃ, Be, Ce so, mc; Ee, Se ~aṃ); Thī 29 (kiñcāpi kho ’mhi ~ā dubbalā gatayobbanā); Ja II 437, 14* (rogena bāḷhaṃ dukhitassa ruppato, Be, Ce so, mc; Ee, Se ~assa) quoted Vism 49, 14* ; Ja IV 17, 23 (sattāhaṃ nirāhāratāya ~o); VI 508, 28* (yā sāmike ~amhi sukhaṃ icchanti attano); Ap 589, 8 (cittaṃ ca ~aṃ n’ atthi); Bv 2:18 (kilesavyādhīhi ~o paripīḷito); Mil 61, 23 (puriso visaṃ … attanā ca piveyya … so attanā pi ~o bhaveyya); 281, 22 (tassa atipemena ~assa balavasoko uppajji); Vism 513, 1* (dukkham eva hi na koci ~o); Mhv 37:26 (Mahāvihāranāsamhi ~ā); Sadd 328, 29 ; — atidukkhita, mfn. , very distressed ; Pj II 99, 12 ; — sudukkhita, mfn. , very distressed ; Thī 79; Ap 305, 10 ; — caus. ( b ) pr. 3 sg. dukkhāpeti , ~ayati [ BHS duḥkhāpayati], hurts, inflicts pain on ; Ja II 237, 8´ (mitte sukhāpetuṃ amitte vā ~etuṃ na sakkotī ti); IV 452, 29* (dukkhitaṃ maṃ ~āpayase Sudhamme; 453, 4´ : pakatiyā pi maṃ dukkhitaṃ bhiyyo ~āpayasi); Ps II 20, 23 (ime dārakā aññe dārake vināsenti ~enti); III 9, 27 (attānaṃ tapati ~etī ti attantapo); Mhv 38:88 (~etuṃ); Sadd 328, 1 (~eti ~ayatī ti); — neg. part.pr. adukkhāpenta, mfn. , Ja V 167, 32´ ; Ap-a 130, 5 ; — absol. dukkhāpetvā, Ja III 468, 9* (sukhakāme ~etvā); Mil 276, 14 (yo paraṃ ~etvā dānaṃ deti); — pass. part.pr. dukkhāpī̆yamāna, mfn. , Ud-a 174, 4 (pīḷiyamāno ~iyamāno) ≠ It-a I 179, 2 ( Be, Ce, Se ~iyamānā; Ee ~īyamānā); — pp dukkhāpita, mfn. , Ja V 284, 15 (mama hattho ~ito ti); Mil 79, 10 ; Ap-a 278, 30 (aṭṭito abhibhūto ~ito, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee dukkhapīḷito); — fpp dukkhāpetabba, mfn. , Sv 986, 10 (saṅkhāro hi ~etabbo nāma n’ atthi); — see also dukkhī̆yati.
